timeline.summary: The shapeshifter Halfdane takes the form of a mold demon in his fight with Ayesha Tanaka and Tor Wauki.
timeline.quote: The shapeshifter Halfdane took the form of a mold demon during his fight with Ayesha Tanaka and Tor Wauki

timeline.summary: The Kentsu strike Kusho; Ayesha is captured by Gosta's defenders and escapes with Ramirez's help.
timeline.quote: Ayesha is captured by the island's defenders

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha takes the Sylvan Library to distract Magnus and tries to contact Kei.
timeline.quote: Ayesha takes the library and tries to contact Kei.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xira infects Kei Takahashi with her offspring to lure Tetsuo to Argenti; Tetsuo and Ayesha Tanaka kill it.
timeline.quote: Xira did this by infecting Kei Takahashi with her offspring.

citation.text: "Xira Arien", section "Eumidian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kei has a vision of Lady Orca murdering Kusho; Tetsuo realizes it is a trap but travels to Kusho with Tor and Ayesha.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo realizes it is a trap of Lord Overdark's creation but has to journey to Kusho to protect his honor

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo breaks out of prison, frees Tor and challenges Caleria to a duel as Overdark activates the Serpent Generator.
timeline.quote: Then Overdark activates the artifact Xira hid for him- a Serpent Generator .

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Caleria is defeated in the duel and lets the group leave; Tetsuo and Ayesha kill the insect inside Kei, halting his mutation.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo and Ayesha engage the insect inside Kei on the Meditation plane and kill it.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xira Arien fights Tor and Ayesha, is seriously wounded and plummets into the sea.
timeline.quote: she is seriously wounded and plummets into the sea.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lady Caleria lets Tetsuo leave, and the insect in Kei is killed though mutations remain.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo and Ayesha did manage to kill the insect in Kei

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "First journey to the Edemis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Overdark has Elsdragon killed and is made regent; Tetsuo, finding Ayesha poisoned, Tor wounded and Kei killed, renounces his title and swears vengeance.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo renounced his title of champion and swore vengeance.

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "Second journey to the Edemis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo reunites with Meha, Tor and Ayesha and sets out to restore the chaotic empire.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo was reunited with Meha, Tor, and Ayesha

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "The aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An Elder Land Wurm announces the Edemi rebellion and the group together kills it.
timeline.quote: teamed up against the wurm and managed to kill it.

citation.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha returns, and with Kasimir's help she and Tor lure Halfdane into a trap by swapping appearances.
timeline.quote: through trickery where Ayesha cast an illusion spell on herself and Tor, swapping their appearance

citation.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After a prolonged battle they trap Halfdane in Shima Pond; Ayesha freezes him and Tor banishes him with black mana, erasing him from existence.
timeline.quote: Tor used black mana to banish him, erasing Halfdane from existence.

citation.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tor and Ayesha return to Madara and celebrate its liberation, rejoining Tetsuo and Kolo Meha in Sekana.
timeline.quote: Tor and Ayesha later returned to Madara and celebrated its liberation

citation.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Argenti Hage learns Ayesha became the forest's avatar and killed all Kentsu there; Overdark rescues Hage.
timeline.quote: Just before he is about to die, Hage is saved by Overdark

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha and the grown coral reefs force the Kentsu to leave Kusho.
timeline.quote: decide to leave

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha cures Kusho of black mana poison and goes with Tor to seek Halfdane.

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha traps Halfdane in a frozen pond and Tor destroys him with a black spell.
timeline.quote: Tor casts a black spell to destroy the shapeshifter.

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Weeks later the friends reunite on Sekana and convince Tetsuo to restore order to the empire.
timeline.quote: he sets off to do just that

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas punishes Tetsuo, who must accompany the kentsu; Ayesha, Kei and Tor are put under kentsu control.

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha is kidnapped by Kusho's defenders, then escapes with Ramirez DePietro's help.

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha falls ill from black mana crystals poisoning Kusho's mana lines, the work of Halfdane in disguise.
timeline.quote: Ramirez was the shapeshifter Halfdane , a minion of Ramses Overdark, in disguise.

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ordered to Argenti, Ayesha leads an attack on the Sylvan Library, secretly seeking cures for her addiction and Kei's mutations.

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha becomes the Library's avatar and, with the forest, defeats the kentsu on Argenti and Kusho.
timeline.quote: She fought against the kentsu, and her cunning was just what the forest needed to get an edge over them.

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Magnus resumes his role and gives Ayesha a cure; Kei is found murdered by Halfdane.
timeline.quote: Halfdane had murdered the boy.

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha freezes the water around Halfdane and Tor kills him with a black spell.
timeline.quote: Ayesha managed to freeze the water around him

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha and Tor reunite with Tetsuo and persuade him to become imperial champion again.
timeline.quote: they convinced him to take up the role of imperial champion once more

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha uses the Sylvan Library to enhance the corals and decimate the Kentsu.
timeline.quote: Ayesha Tanaka used the Sylvan Library to enhance the corals around Kusho to decimate the Kentsu forces.

citation.text: "Kusho", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha and Tor Wauki remove the crystals and kill Halfdane.

timeline.summary: Ayesha Tanaka leads a counterattack that destroys much of the Madaran fleet and liberates Kusho.

timeline.summary: Tor and Ayesha Tanaka cure the manalines and fight Halfdane; Ayesha freezes the water so his reflections mesmerize him and Tor kills him with black-mana magic.
timeline.quote: Then Tor cast a black-mana spell to kill him.

citation.text: "Halfdane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
